# Character pages used by the Name Entry screen.
#
# The builder converts these characters to Secret of Mana's internal text
# encoding. Each page must resolve to exactly 26 selectable entries.
#
# Supported named tokens:
#   <QUOTE_OPEN>  byte C3
#   <QUOTE_CLOSE> byte C4
#   <SPACE>       blank selectable cell
#   <GLYPH_CF>    original font glyph CF
#   <GLYPH_D0>    original font glyph D0
#   <GLYPH_D1>    original font glyph D1
#   <GLYPH_D2>    original font glyph D2
#
# The page framing (two leading blank cells, one trailing blank cell and the
# 7F terminator) is generated by build_patch.py and is not written here.

[uppercase]
ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ

[lowercase]
abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz

[symbols]
0123456789.,/'<QUOTE_OPEN><QUOTE_CLOSE>-<SPACE>!?()<GLYPH_CF><GLYPH_D0><GLYPH_D1><GLYPH_D2>
